data_output.description: The fixed training command must write an NPZ at the requested output path containing exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must be np.arange(len(validation_rows), dtype=np.int64), and scores must be the one-dimensional long_view logits in the original encoded validation-row order. No ground-truth validation labels may be written or used by the model for final scoring; the fixed evaluator alone loads validation ground truth.

model_input.description: model.py must preserve Model(dimension, learning_rate, l2), logits(features), predict(features, batch_size), state(), and load_state(state) interfaces. features is an integer array of shape (N, 2), containing encoded user and video indices; labels is a float array of binary long_view targets used only during training. Preserve additive user/item weights, bias, 16-dimensional user-video dot-product interaction, Adam moments, learning rate, L2 regularization, optimizer step numbering, and logit-only predictions. Replace the pointwise BCE update with focal BCE at gamma=1.5: for each impression use p=sigmoid(logit), loss=-y(1-p)^1.5 log(p)-(1-y)p^1.5 log(1-p), and differentiate this loss with respect to the logit before applying the existing batch averaging, parameter gradients, Adam update, and L2 regularization. Return the mean focal loss, keep prediction outputs as raw long_view logits, and maintain finite outputs and existing empty-input behavior.
